### workspace shell-init --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace shell-init zsh|bash

Print shell functions for your rc file. Add this line (in zsh, after compinit):

  eval "$(workspace shell-init zsh)"

It defines wf, a short workflow start: wf [-w ID] [--dry-run] [--] REF|TEXT.
The text is fixed; nothing from your workflows is put into it. There is no --json.

Examples:
  workspace shell-init zsh    # the text for zsh
  workspace shell-init bash    # the text for bash 3.2 or later
  workspace shell-init zsh > ~/.workspace.zsh    # write it once, source the file
--- stderr
--- end
